subject: Reappointment of a Chairperson of the Civilian Review and Complaints Commission for the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, on an interim basis
precis: Reappointment of the Honourable W. Brent Cotter, S.O.M, K.C., of Halifax, Nova Scotia, as Chairperson of the Civilian Review and Complaints Commission for the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, on an interim basis, to hold office during good behaviour for a term of six months, effective October 15, 2026.
